integrity: The proof uses previously established configuration-model generating-function relations and gives a new exact optimization of the specified restricted family; no finite experiment is represented as an infinite proof.
limitations: Independent Bernoulli transmission on an asymptotic configuration-model network only
Optimality is restricted to mean-three distributions supported on degrees 1,3,5
The order parameter is the macroscopic component fraction, not a one-seed unconditional expected outbreak
Originality assessment is literature-limited; an unindexed equivalent could exist
title: Exact three-regime epidemic-size optimization for degree-one/three/five networks
